name: Lords’ Alliance Agent

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Once per turn on a Critical Hit against a creature, grant Heroic Inspiration to an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you and lacks it. After a visible enemy damages an ally within 5 feet of you, your next attack against that enemy has Advantage until your next turn ends.
